calibration_policy.ECE: Optional only with a consistently preregistered binning procedure

comparison_policy.confidence_intervals: Paired lineage-group bootstrap where supported; resample identical groups for baseline/candidate.
comparison_policy.finite_sample_limit: At small negative counts, 1% budgets are coarse; empirical compliance is not a population guarantee.
comparison_policy.fixed_FPR: Empirical attainable thresholds using whole tied-score blocks, no interpolation/randomized tie splitting; choose maximal recall satisfying budget. Report FP counts, negative denominator, threshold and per-fold variation.

confidence_interval_policy.method: Preregister dependence-aware methods later; use lineage-group paired bootstrap where supported; counts/denominators and interval assumptions mandatory.
confidence_interval_policy.stretch_target: 1-3% FPR/FNR is a stretch system-level engineering target to be evaluated on a sufficiently large untouched benchmark with confidence intervals.

cycle_policy.counts_as_cycle: Meaningful feature/model redesign followed by development evaluation
cycle_policy.stop: After two substantive unsuccessful cycles, stop tuning and report limitations.

diversity_rule: DO NOT OPTIMIZE INDIVIDUAL DETECTORS AT THE EXPENSE OF COMPLEMENTARY FAILURE BEHAVIOR.

dm_b_promotion_policy.materiality_and_compute_limits: Must be preregistered in later candidate authorization before candidate results; not invented here.
dm_b_promotion_policy.primary: Improve recall at one or more fixed FPR budgets, not arbitrary cutpoint 0.5 dominance.

ds_promotion_policy.F_definition: Attack false-negative event, on matched permitted samples at recorded operating points.
ds_promotion_policy.M_definition: Exact semantic membership must be frozen during integration; not selected here.
ds_promotion_policy.unique_catch_definition: Fraction of positive samples caught by S and missed by all other specified base detectors; report denominator and counts.

lineage.residual_risk: Near-duplicate/template/semantic and upstream lineage remain unresolved; no independence claim.
lineage.scope: Approved exact canonical duplicate lineage minimum only; not full documentary/semantic lineage.

oof_rules.baseline: Later authorized OOF baselines require fold-local recipe reproductions; a whole-BASE_TRAIN fitted v1 model cannot yield honest OOF predictions. Original v1 artifacts remain untouched.
oof_rules.engineering_thresholds: Development choices only; never final operating-point claims
oof_rules.external_guard: Externally frozen guard needs no project-data fitting; any later execution requires authorization.
oof_rules.fit_scope: All learned preprocessing/model/calibration must be fold-local using only outer-training rows; inner splits remain lineage-aware.
oof_rules.held_out_fold: Each BASE_TRAIN sample is held out exactly once and trainable in the other four folds.

partition_definitions.BASE_TRAIN: Development engineering and fixed lineage-aware CV; not unbiased final testing.
partition_definitions.CALIBRATION: Separate calibration fitting only when later explicitly authorized; excluded from CV engineering.
partition_definitions.FINAL_TEST: Final untouched system evaluation with confidence intervals.
partition_definitions.FROZEN_EXTERNAL: Final untouched external system evaluation; conceptual alias of FINAL_TEST.
partition_definitions.INTERNAL_TEST: Internal research measurement; must not influence detector tuning.
partition_definitions.VALIDATION: Later authorized candidate promotion/calibration-threshold-policy gate; not model engineering.

quality_objective: min FNR_system subject to FPR_system <= alpha

future_policies_not_selected: D: C plus small random benign-consensus audit
verifier_router_boundary.verifier_selection: P(V_k detects attack | base stack failed)
